text:
Maya Chen: PSA - bringing up the Mistral-quantized fork; getting heavy repetition even though HF generation_config looked normal
Raj Patel: paste the HF generation_config.json?
Maya Chen: shipped with:
```
{"temperature": 0.9, "top_p": 0.95, "repetition_penalty": 1.05}
```
Lucas O'Neil: HF omitted top_k; note newer HF loaders assume model defaults (top_k==0 disables)
Ciara Nguyen: Redwood's conversion defaults top_k=50 if missing — that plus 8-bit quant and rep_penalty lowish can amplify repeats :grimacing: 
Maya Chen: short repro:
```
Input: "The recipe calls for"
Float model: "the the same the mixture"
Quantized 8-bit: "the the the the the"
```
Raj Patel: what did Redwood actually send to runtime?
Maya Chen: mapped payload we sent:
```
{"temperature":"0.9","top_p":"0.95","top_k":"50","repetition_penalty":"1.05"}
```
Maya Chen: notice numbers are strings - our HF->Redwood converter stringifies numeric fields for old configs
Lucas O'Neil: runtime coercion bug: some quantized codepaths cast rep_penalty string -> int(1), effectively disabling it. combined with default top_k makes sampling unstable
Ciara Nguyen: another issue: chat template special tokens. our template appends <|endofuser|> but HF model's eos_token_id is different -> tokenizer produces duplicate separators which worsens repetition especially with greedy/beam fallbacks
Maya Chen: example:
```
HF config: "eos_token_id": 2 ("</s>")
chat template token id: 50256 for "<|endofuser|>"
```
Raj Patel: summary: (1) serializer turning numbers into strings -> type coercion, (2) default top_k injection interacts with quantization, (3) special token id mismatch in template
Ciara Nguyen: short-term mitigations:
- fix converter to preserve numeric types (PR ready)
- lower default top_k=10 in quantized canary
- add lint: verify template token ids exist in tokenizer.vocab and match eos/bos when expected
Lucas O'Neil: diagnostics: run 100-prompt sweep computing n-gram repetition metric across top_k and rep_penalty. quick sweep showed rep_penalty parsed correctly reduces repeats, but string->int parsing kills the effect
Maya Chen: quick results:
```
(top_k=50, rep="1.05" -> parsed int 1) rep_rate=0.43
(top_k=50, rep=1.05 float) rep_rate=0.12
(top_k=10, rep=1.05 float) rep_rate=0.08
```
Raj Patel: also be careful: our sampler applies top_p then top_k which can produce weird effective supports when both set
Ciara Nguyen: action items:
- @lucas: land runtime fix to assert numeric types and safe coercion
- @maya: update converter, add unit tests
- @raj: run canary with top_k=10 on quantized model and report repetition metric
- add template-token lint to onboarding checks
Maya Chen: opening PRs and will paste links here. thanks :thumbsup:
ops-deploy-bot: deploy-canary started rw-canary-3 (build 2024.11.3-quant-sampfix)
Lucas O'Neil: note: changing default top_k requires changelog/model-onboarding note
Maya Chen: adding to release notes and onboarding checklist
